summary: performance lens over assistant-ask-surfaces (13 product path(s), e24a8bd..8dd1cbc, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 0 blocking, 2 non-blocking. The feature implementation is broadly coherent, but it introduces two avoidable scaling defects on the core Ask path: unbounded conversation payload growth and quadratic suppression lookup during table rendering. Both can materially increase latency or make long sessions and large suppressed results unusable.

non_blocking_findings.summary: [P2] Bound prior turns before rebuilding every request (frontend/src/features/assistant/use-ask.ts:27): Every successful turn is copied into every subsequent request with no count or token-budget bound.

[P2] Pre-index suppressed cells instead of scanning them for every cell (frontend/src/features/assistant/ask-panel.tsx:360): Each rendered table cell calls `isSuppressed`, which performs a linear scan of `suppressedCells`.
